description:
Spec author (Mark) reversed the previously-locked-in single-owner design for Space. The new spec direction: the JMAP Chat draft will NOT declare a normative ownership field on the `Space` object; "who controls a Space" is implementation-defined / out-of-band. The Space type, the `Space/set` create-arm, and the `SPACE_READONLY` list need to revert to the pre-cd89717 shape.

See JMAP-g7wu.2.4.11 NOTES for the 2026-05-11 lock-in and 2026-05-12 reversal trail.

## What to revert (workspace commit cd89717)

1. **jmap-chat-types** (`crate-jmap-chat-types/src/space.rs`):
   - Remove the `owner_id: Id` field from `Space`.
   - Revert `Space::new` from 11 args back to 10.
   - Remove the `space_owner_id_round_trips` test.
   - Revert the 3 existing test JSON fixtures that were updated to include `ownerId`.

2. **jmap-chat-server** (`crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs`):
   - Revert `handle_space_set` create-arm: remove the `B::principal_id(caller).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| account_id.clone())` owner assignment.
   - Remove `"ownerId"` from the `SPACE_READONLY` list.

3. **crate-jmap-chat-server/PLAN.md**:
   - Remove the "Reserved for future spec work" section that pointed at JMAP-pep4. Note: JMAP-pep4 was referenced in comment trails but was never actually created as a bead, so there is no bead to close.

## Acceptance

- Single revert commit named `revert: Space.ownerId per spec author redirect to implementation-defined ownership`.
- `cargo test --workspace` passes.
- `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` clean.
- `RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --no-deps -p jmap-chat-types -p jmap-chat-server -p jmap-chat-client` clean.
- `grep -ri 'owner_id\|ownerId' crate-jmap-chat-types crate-jmap-chat-server crate-jmap-chat-client` returns zero matches (or only matches in PLAN.md / AGENTS.md that are explicit historical references with a "removed per JMAP-..." annotation).
- bd:JMAP-g7wu.2.4.3's acceptance criteria no longer reference `owner_id` (re-scoped separately as part of this design pivot).

## Out of scope

- The spec-side edit (Mark hands a prompt to the spec-repo opencode separately).
- Re-scoping bd:JMAP-g7wu.2.4.3 acceptance criteria (separate metadata change, lands as part of the design-pivot cleanup but is not part of this code revert).
- Designing replacement "server-defined destroy authorization" and "last-admin-removal protection" hooks. Those are part of the re-scoped .4.3 work.
title: Revert Space.ownerId workspace impl — spec author redirected to implementation-defined ownership
